columns.caption: Unassigned Tickets
columns.formula: IF ISNULL([ASSIGNEE]) OR [ASSIGNEE] = 'Not Assigned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

columns.name: Calculation_1190076214110629889
columns.caption: Ticket Logs Upper Line
columns.formula:
"Issue Key : "+[ISSUE_KEY] +"     "+
" | Priority : "+[PRIORITY] +"     "+ 
" | Story Points: " + STR([STORY_POINTS]) +"     "+
" | Status: " + [STATUS]
+CHAR(10)

columns.name: Calculation_1210060939597680646
columns.caption: Sprint Filter Calc
columns.formula:
IF [Parameters].[Parameter 3] = "Current Sprint" THEN
    [Calculation_1210060939597414404] = [Calculation_1210060939597574149]

ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 3] = "Previous Sprint" THEN
    [Calculation_1210060939597414404] = [Calculation_1210060939597574149] - 1
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 3] = "Last 6 Sprints" THEN
    [Calculation_1210060939597414404] >= [Calculation_1210060939597574149] - 5
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 3] = "Last 12 Sprints" THEN
    [Calculation_1210060939597414404] >= [Calculation_1210060939597574149] - 11
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 3] = "Last 20 Sprints" THEN
    [Calculation_1210060939597414404] >= [Calculation_1210060939597574149] - 19
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 3] = "Current YTD" THEN
    YEAR([SPRINT_END_DATE]) = YEAR(TODAY())
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 3] = "Last Year" THEN
    YEAR([SPRINT_END_DATE]) = YEAR(TODAY()) - 1
 
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 3] = "Next 2 Sprints" THEN
    [Calculation_1210060939597414404] > [Calculation_1210060939597574149]
    AND [Calculation_1210060939597414404] <= [Calculation_1210060939597574149] + 2
END

columns.name: Calculation_1435803884644544512
columns.caption: Sort Calc
columns.formula:
IF [Parameters].[Parameter 8] = 'Summary' THEN (CASE [Parameters].[Parameter 9] 
WHEN 'Ascending' THEN RANK_UNIQUE(MIN([SUMMARY]),'asc')
WHEN  'Descending' THEN RANK_UNIQUE(min([SUMMARY]),'desc') END)

ELSEIF 

[Parameters].[Parameter 8] = 'Status' THEN (CASE [Parameters].[Parameter 9] 
WHEN 'Ascending' THEN RANK_UNIQUE(min([STATUS]),'asc')
WHEN  'Descending' THEN RANK_UNIQUE(min([STATUS]),'desc') END)

ELSEIF 

[Parameters].[Parameter 8] = 'Issue Key' THEN (CASE [Parameters].[Parameter 9] 
WHEN 'Ascending' THEN RANK_UNIQUE(min([ISSUE_KEY]),'asc')
WHEN  'Descending' THEN RANK_UNIQUE(min([ISSUE_KEY]),'desc') END)

ELSEIF 

[Parameters].[Parameter 8] = 'Epic' THEN (CASE [Parameters].[Parameter 9] 
WHEN 'Ascending' THEN RANK_UNIQUE(min([EPIC]),'asc')
WHEN  'Descending' THEN RANK_UNIQUE(min([EPIC]),'desc') END)

END

columns.name: Calculation_626844788507688963
columns.caption: Ticket Type Calc
columns.formula:
IF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Total' THEN
    TRUE
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Rollover' THEN
    [ROLLOVER_FLAG] = 'YES'
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Unassigned' THEN
    ISNULL([ASSIGNEE])
    OR [ASSIGNEE] = 'Not Assigned'
    OR TRIM([ASSIGNEE]) = ''
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Assigned' THEN
    NOT (
        ISNULL([ASSIGNEE])
        OR [ASSIGNEE] = 'Not Assigned'
        OR TRIM([ASSIGNEE]) = ''
    )
END

columns.name: Calculation_908882727947681792
columns.caption: Story Point Calc
columns.formula:
IF [Parameters].[Parameter 10] = 'Story Points = 0' THEN SUM([STORY_POINTS]) = 0
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 10] = 'Story Points <> 0' THEN SUM([STORY_POINTS]) > 0
ELSE TRUE
END

columns.name: Calculation_994732597222805504
columns.caption: Zero/NonZero
columns.formula:
IF [STORY_POINTS] = 0 THEN "Story Points = 0"
ELSE "Story Points <> 0"
END
